edition_policy: Fixed legacy and updated current only; previous 猜ˢ retained as a current reverse-only alias.
rationale: Explicit user adoption. Purely theoretical reasoning is represented by 思辨; diven and konjekt keep 猜 and 猜ᴷ. 11 to 25 strokes accepted for semantic clarity; both characters are already shared.
known_literal_or_concat_ambiguity: 思辨 can formerly be read as pens+disting; the adopted complete root wins in current plain inverse. Standard HTML keeps source information.
